ocr.markdown:
THE BEST COWBOY CAVIAR
Ingredients:
·1/2 cup diced orange bell pepper
·1/2 cup diced red bell pepper
·1-2 cans of sweet corn;drained
·1-2 cans of black beans; drained
·1-2 cans of black-eyed peas;drained
·1 cup Cilantro; diced fine
·1/2 cup diced purple onion
·1 tbsp fresh lime juice
·1/4 tsp Garlic Powder
·1 tsp Chili powder
·1/2 tsp Salt
·1/4 cup sugar
·1/2 cup olive oil
·1/3 cup white wine
vinegar
·1/2 tsp cayenne pepper
(if wanting spice)
Instructions:
1. Add all ingredients into a large bowl
2 mix well and place in fridge for a bit before
serving.
3. Serve with crackers or scoop tortilla chips.
